start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj Perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh bahut akela aur bhaari lag raha hai. Kya aap abhi theek hain?

Aapne mujhe batakar bilkul sahi kiya. Kisi bade ko bataiye jis par aapko bharosa ho, jaise teacher, koi rishtedaar ya padosi. Childline 1098 par kabhi bhi free call kar sakte hain. Mann ki pareshani ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 hai. Aap abhi safe hain?
